output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
x <- read.csv("../data/2024-07-02_irAE mouse weights-cleaned.csv") 
```

```{r}
x %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = days, y = weight, color = group)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_smooth()

ggsave("../figures/mouse-weights-time.png", height = 4, width = 6)
```
